method: Coverage priorities, not a statistical rank or an estimate of home-garden prevalence. National crop groups use different metrics; no tonnage comparison across groups.

sources.evidence: Official final national horticulture figures; contents independently retrieved through Firecrawl PDF parsing, including chili, shallot, tomato, banana and the next horticulture cohort.
BPS national paddy/maize release discovered in research; no final full-year totals or rank asserted here.
Official plantation publication series; retrieval blocked, quantitative plantation comparisons remain incomplete.

limitations: Crop prioritization is a product coverage decision, not a claim of household prevalence.
The broader statistical research stopped at its credit cap; official BPS horticulture summary and contents were subsequently retrieved directly. No unverified numerical ranking is used.
Chemical product coverage requires separate crop-target label and current-registration checks, regardless of crop priority.
